'''Walking Human Heads''' are the [[Walking Heads]] of [[Assimilated Human|Assimilated Humans]].

==''Spawning''==
*Spawned with a 50% chance when an Assimilated Human dies.
*Spawned by [[Worm|Worms]] through Level 3 [[Scent System|Scents]].

==''Behavior''==
Walking Human Heads are cowardly Melee swarm units.
*Walking Human Heads' Melee Attack is performed through contact damage.
* Walking Human Heads can perform small leaps.
*They will seek out [[Medium Incomplete Form|Medium Incomplete Forms]] to merge with in order to evolve back into Assimilated Humans.
*Any Mob within 3 blocks of a Walking Human Head will be inflicted with [[Call Of The Hive|COTH]]. This does not go through walls.
*Walking Human Heads are able to traverse faster in liquids by performing small leaps.
{{Variants|customdesc=*Walking Human Heads have 1 variant, spawning from the <span style="color:#AAAAAA;">Nocturn</span> variant of the Assimilated Human:|count=1|Texture=Assimilated_Human_HeadV.png|TextureDesc=has identical stats.}}

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===

* Walking Human Heads, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.
* Walking Human Heads will run away during the daytime if no other parasites are present.
